entities.title: Interpolate an object that moved down a slot from its own pose
entities.summary: When an object leaves the bubble, the objects after it shift down a slot, and the next frame interpolates each from the pose of the object that was in its new slot.
entities.expected: An object that moved down a slot is drawn between its own previous and current positions.
entities.actual: SimHost keeps the previous poses by slot; a shifted object of the same kind as the slot's previous occupant is interpolated from that other object's position and orientation for one tick.
acceptanceCriteria: After a removal, every remaining object is interpolated from its own previous pose
